rows.ja: 買収した発電所・取引先

companies.name: エナジー・キャピタル・パートナーズ

relations.text: オハイオ州・インディアナ州のガス火力3か所(Cornerstone)を同社の関連会社から買収予定
relations.text_en: Agreed to buy three gas plants in Ohio and Indiana (the Cornerstone deal) from its affiliates

source.label: Talen Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our pending acquisition of the 875 MW Waterford Energy Center and 456 MW Darby Generating Station in Ohio and the 1,120 MW Lawrenceburg Power Plant in Indiana from Energy Capital Partners.

companies.name: モキシー・フリーダム

relations.text: ペンシルベニア州のフリーダム発電所の保有会社を2025年11月に全持分取得
relations.text_en: Bought all interests in the owner of the Freedom plant in Pennsylvania in November 2025

source.label: Talen Energy 8-K(2025年11月、買収完了)
source.quote: acquired all of the issued and outstanding membership interests in (i) Moxie Freedom LLC, a Delaware limited liability company

relations.text: オハイオ州のガーンジー発電所の保有会社を2025年11月に全持分取得
relations.text_en: Bought all interests in the owner of the Guernsey plant in Ohio in November 2025

source.label: Talen Energy 8-K(2025年11月、買収完了)
source.quote: (ii) Guernsey Power Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company

relations.text: AWSとの電力購入契約(PPA)で、データセンター向けに原子力の無炭素電力を大量に供給
relations.text_en: Supplies large volumes of carbon-free nuclear power to AWS data centers under the AWS PPA

source.label: Talen Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our AWS PPA is an example of how we are powering the future in partnership with data center and artificial intelligence enterprises and, in the case of the AWS PPA, doing so with large volumes of clean, carbon-free energy.

relations.text: Talen、PJM、PPL Electric Utilitiesの3者で、原子力発電所からデータセンターへの追加送電を認める契約変更を申請(FERCが2024年に却下)
relations.text_en: Talen, PJM and PPL Electric Utilities sought an amended agreement to send more nuclear power to an adjacent data center (FERC rejected it in 2024)

source.label: PSEG 10-Q(2024年第3四半期)
source.quote: On November 1, 2024, FERC issued an order rejecting an amended agreement between Talen Energy (Talen), PJM and PPL Electric Utilities that would have permitted Talen to withdraw incremental power from one of its nuclear units beyond previous approvals to provide power to an adjacent data center.

companies.name: テラウルフ
companies.sub: ビットコイン採掘・AIデータセンター

relations.text: 合弁のビットコイン採掘施設(Nautilus)の持分25%をTeraWulfからTalenが買い取った
relations.text_en: Talen bought TeraWulf's 25% stake in their Nautilus bitcoin-mining joint venture

source.label: TeraWulf の発表(8-K添付)
source.quote: today announced it has completed the sale of its 25% equity interest in the Nautilus Cryptomine joint venture ("Nautilus") to its partner, a subsidiary of Talen Energy Corporation ("Talen")

companies.name: コンステレーション・エナジー

relations.text: Talenは、Constellation、Calpine、Amazon、Microsoft、Googleと共に、大口電力需要の接続方法について共同提案をPJMに出した
relations.text_en: Talen filed a joint proposal on large-load additions in PJM together with Constellation, Calpine, Amazon, Microsoft and Google

source.label: Talen Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company was an active participant in the CIFP process and submitted a joint proposal amongst itself, Constellation, Calpine, Amazon, Microsoft, and Google representing the group's collective views on the best approach to large load additions.
